description_zh: 调用UninstallSoftware卸载指定集群中已安装的软件
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc uninstall-software --cluster-id ehpc-hz-jeJki60000 --application ABYSS_2.1.5 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallSoftware

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the software that you want to uninstall.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188591.html operation to query the software that is installed in the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
待卸载的软件名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188591.html查询集群已安装的软件列表
parameters.name: application
